items.why_en: Meshy 3D Agent officially launched this month, integrating the Meshy 6 model to generate print-ready 3D models from text, images, or sketches, with new 8K textures and auto-split features, significantly boosting efficiency and quality for game modules and 3D printing assets.

items.name: Tripo AI
items.why: Tripo AI 於本月更新至 3.1 版本，並推出 Tripo 3.1 Multi View，強化從單一或多視角圖像生成高品質、遊戲引擎友善的 3D 模型能力，提供更精確的幾何形狀與 PBR 紋理。
items.why_en: Tripo AI updated to version 3.1 this month, introducing Tripo 3.1 Multi View, enhancing its ability to generate high-quality, game-engine-friendly 3D models from single or multi-view images, offering more precise geometry and PBR textures.

items.name: 3D AI Studio
items.why: 作為一個整合多個頂級 AI 3D 模型（包括 Meshy、Rodin、Tripo、Hunyuan）的平台，3D AI Studio 於本月持續更新，提供一站式解決方案，讓用戶能靈活選擇最適合其需求的 AI 模型，並內建圖像生成功能。
items.why_en: As a platform integrating multiple top AI 3D models (including Meshy, Rodin, Tripo, Hunyuan), 3D AI Studio continued its updates this month, offering a one-stop solution for users to flexibly choose the best AI model for their needs, with built-in image generation capabilities.

items.name: Hitem 3D
items.why: Hitem 3D 2.1 在 6 月底的評測中被譽為最適合 3D 列印的 AI 3D 生成器，其模型具有極高的列印就緒度，幾乎沒有非流形邊緣或交叉面，大幅減少後處理工作。
items.why_en: Hitem 3D 2.1 was lauded in a late June review as the best AI 3D generator for 3D printing, producing models with high print-readiness, almost no non-manifold edges or intersecting faces, significantly reducing post-processing.

items.name: Hunyuan3D
items.why: Hunyuan3D 於 4 月宣布推出 HY-World 2.0，將其生態系統從單一物件生成擴展到可探索的 3D 世界創建，支援從文字或圖像輸入生成遊戲環境和 VR 世界，是其平台的重要新功能。
items.why_en: Hunyuan3D announced HY-World 2.0 in April, expanding its ecosystem from single object generation to explorable 3D world creation, supporting text or image input for game environments and VR worlds, a significant new feature for its platform.

items.name: Unreal Engine 5.8 Rigging and Animation Tools Updates
